value.rationale: The original stochastic reinforcement model naturally raises when to deploy exactly k opposite-colour mixing actions. The theorem solves that all-schedules design problem exactly for every size and starting composition, and shows the resulting imbalance advantage persists after infinite pure-Pólya evolution. Its sign change shows early mixing is not a superficial universal rule; the restriction to one mathematically natural quadratic risk and nonadaptive timing is explicit.
